estimand.confirmatory: P = (temperature, tau 0.1, all, DR), P_D = (temperature, tau 0.1, D_1se, DR): mean over the estimation population of A_t = sum_a [pi(a) - reference(a)] Q_b(H_t, a); WE per decision
estimand.pa_first_D:0: mean over PAs of the deviation at the first D_0 decision (0 without one); WE per PA
estimand.populations: prediag: E0 rows with a recorded result (independent of G); estimation: those of PAs with an observed PA-end reward
estimand.row_rules: SUPPORTED: D = M_dr + (rho' - rho_r)(G - q_dr[a]); off-mask rows: D = M_dr
estimand.not: not a policy value, not the full-PA L1-R deviation, not a causal effect; <=2025 DEV exploratory

candidate_search.q: RolloutImprovement MC of the reference continuation

we_identity.terminal: game.terminal_values: initial-defender WE after each terminal event
we_identity.cutoff: WinExpectancy.predict_defense at the initial PA state

crosscheck.rule: policy_estimator.pa_value on the ledger rows + frame facts reproduces the sealed pa_values row

interpretations.noise_exemption: the noise-criterion exemption applies to the policy (temperature, tau 0.1), hence to both confirmatory contrasts P and P_D (the ESS and cluster criteria still apply to each)
interpretations.stage2_tau_ranking: with no GAIN, path (ii) takes the tau in E with the largest max-t statistic t_tau = delta_hat / SE_tau, SE_tau = max(SE_game, SE_pitcher) (the same SE as max-t); ties -> the larger tau
interpretations.holm_not_evaluable: a NOT_EVALUABLE contrast enters Holm with p = 1; m stays 2
interpretations.s_pos_rule: S-pos keeps the sign and its 95% CI excludes 0 in the same direction in both bootstraps
interpretations.reproduction_phase_a: before prediag only the 7 G-free pa_values columns are read and phase (a) classifies with the reward value masked; the value columns and the PA-end values enter only after prediag.json (phase b, attach_rewards)
interpretations.gate_population: every prediag metric and the gate are computed on the estimation-eligible decisions (P: all, P_D: D_1se); the all-kept-rows count is reported second
interpretations.shuffle_donors: outcome_shuffle_null donors are drawn with replacement among the same pitcher's eligible PAs in other games (never the PA itself or its game)
interpretations.path_ii: path (ii) needs |E| >= 2, a significant max-t, and at the chosen tau the perm paired CI > 0 and S-pos retention (subset all)

ledger-dev-paired-identity.jsonl.note: S6-dr-a5 manifest; the cand=ref paired identity ledger is not read

processed_frame_aligned.note: A2 split-aligned copy; the loader reads processed/pitches.parquet instead

processed_frame_aligned_identity_manifes.note: identity manifest of the aligned copy; not read

identity_check.rule: kl_policy(q_planning, reference, mask, sealed tau) == recorded candidate; ratios rtol 1e-12 where logging[a] > 0; positivity rows exact zeros

row_identity.rule: S = sum_{a: logging(a) > 0} logging(a) row_term(a; G') == 0 for every row with a result, every family x tau

guards.available_memory_formula: (Pages free + Pages inactive + Pages speculative) x page size (vm_stat)

disagreement.definition: argmax_mask q_planning != argmax_mask reference and q[best] - q[ref_best] > k; k = '1se' is q_planning_diff_se[argmax reference]; ties outside every D

common.population: estimation-eligible decisions (E0 PA, observed G, result recorded)

prediag.noise_numerator: c x max_mask(q_planning_diff_se) (c = 1 except shrinkage; cross_replicate uses q_planning_diff_se as a proxy)

row_identity.policies: perm and estimator_stress, every draw and tau

sensitivities.variants: IPS-only, SN-DR and the switch caps are the dose_response variants of each family

s_pos.rule: whole PAs containing a logging-positivity node excluded; retention = same sign and the 95% CI excludes 0 in the same direction in both bootstraps

cross_replicate.rule: policy from q_reference, DR with q_planning

placebos.reading_rule: paired differences real - placebo on the shared bootstrap resampling; bands (2.5-97.5% of the K draw means) only for the stochastic placebos

donor.reason: a same-count / same-mask donor does not exist for every decision; dropping or defaulting those changes the placebo population (needs a design decision)

outcome_shuffle_null.scope: tau 0.1 x confirmatory contrasts x (dr, ips)

bootstrap.replicate_invalid: no decision of the subset in the replicate, or a non-finite statistic
bootstrap.paired: one multiplicity matrix per unit for every family, variant, subset, tau and placebo
bootstrap.trend_seed_use: registered; unused: trend and max-t use the shared replicates (paired)
